$comment: Single source of truth for colours and type. Run `npm run brand` (or any build) to regenerate components/brand.css. Logo colours are fixed by assets/logos/logo-guide.md and are never themed. accentText is the accent for TYPE: it keeps WCAG AA contrast on its ground (the brand orange #FF7D1A is only 2.2:1 on cream).
name: Shtëpia.ime

rules: Never recolour, stretch, rotate, outline, shadow or gradient the door.
Never put the orange door on mid-tone or busy photos: use symbol-white or symbol-black there.
The knob is a hole: never fill it.
Clear space: at least 1/7 of the door's width on every side.

paper.label: Paper — the app's light theme, warm cream ground

orange.label: Orange flood — accent as ground for bold type beats (#E85D00 keeps white type ≥3:1)

navy.label: Navy trust — alternative for finance/bank-partner campaigns

mono.label: Monochrome — black and white with a single orange point

voice.tone: Warm, confident, editorial. Short sentences. Never hype words like 'revolutionary' or 'best ever'.
voice.headlineStyle: Serif headline; the payoff words in italic orange: 'Gjej *shtëpinë tënde.*'
voice.kicker: Mono, uppercase, wide tracking — like a catalogue plate number.
